papers.title_en: Fear Is Not Always Fear: Variation in Emotion Label Equivalence Across Datasets
papers.evidence: 跨数据集情感标签等价性差异
papers.tldr: 情感分类器常被跨数据集使用，默认 fear、surprise 等同名标签含义一致。研究比较 GoEmotions、XED、BRIGHTER 共享的五类标签，在相同输入与跨语料迁移下测试模型。同一批文本中，两个 fear 分类器分别标记 71% 与 8%，但排序基本一致；30 组资源-标签比较显示训练标签流行度解释约一半尺度差异，拟合截距可消除多数。然而校准无法修复迁移造成的 55% 判别力损失，surprise 的资源分歧使外部推文比较结论相反，即使秩归一化后亦然，说明同名标签并非可互换测量目标。
papers.abstract_en: Emotion classifiers are routinely applied beyond their training data, on the assumption that same-named labels such as fear or surprise mean the same thing across resources. We test this assumption for five labels shared by GoEmotions, XED, and BRIGHTER, comparing models on identical inputs and under cross-corpus transfer. On the same texts, one fear classifier flags 71% as fearful and another 8%, yet the two largely agree on how the texts rank. Across 30 resource-label comparisons, training-label prevalence explains about half of this kind of scale mismatch, and a fitted intercept removes most of it. What recalibration cannot repair is larger: transferred models lose 55% of native discrimination in aggregate, agreement in ranking between classifiers is only weakly related to that loss, and for surprise the resources disagree about which texts express the emotion. The choice of training resource can therefore change conclusions: on two external tweet collections, BRIGHTER- and XED-trained classifiers give opposite answers about which shows more surprise, even after rank normalization, with intervals excluding zero in both directions. A shared emotion label name does not establish an interchangeable measurement target.

papers.evidence: 混合情感标签破坏固定极性映射
papers.tldr: 问题背景：情绪数据集常把每个情绪类别固定映射为正或负效价。核心方法：作者在 SemEval-2018、EmoBank、GoEmotions、标签语料及受控标注中检验该做法。关键结果：单一效价标签时固定投影有效，但情绪标签方向冲突的样本仅占 9.0%，却造成学习投影 54.8% 的极性错误。贡献意义：建议投影标签配置而非标签，并在冲突时弃权或保留混合类。
papers.abstract_en: Emotion datasets are routinely mapped onto positive and negative valence, by assigning each emotion category one polarity. We test where this works and where it fails, using SemEval-2018 Affect in Tweets (English, Arabic, Spanish), Affective Text aligned with EmoBank, raw GoEmotions annotations, naturalistic hashtag corpora, and a controlled annotation study. Fixed projection works well when a text carries labels of one valence. It fails on a subset identifiable from the labels alone: tweets whose emotion labels point in opposite directions. These are 9.0% of polar SemEval test tweets but cause 54.8% of the polarity errors of a learned projection, are more than twice as likely to receive a neutral-or-mixed gold label, and are not rescued by modeling the full label set. Annotators produce such configurations routinely: 16.3% of multilabel GoEmotions judgments combine emotions from the dataset's own positive and negative parents. In a controlled study holding word and reader constant, context changes the coarse valence judgment in 56.8% of cases, against 19.9% for controls. We recommend projecting label configurations rather than labels, abstaining or keeping a mixed class where labels conflict, and reporting coverage alongside accuracy.

papers.title_en: DEFT: Disentanglement-Enhanced Fine-Tuning for EEG Foundation Models
papers.authors: Yuqiu Deng, Muyun Jiang, Zongpeng Zhang, Mingqing Xiao, Yansen Wang, Peiliang Gong, Xinliang Zhou, Yi Ding, Ziyu Jia, Cuntai Guan, Chenyu Liu
papers.evidence: 为跨被试EEG解耦被试风格与任务内容
papers.tldr: EEG基础模型借助大规模多被试预训练提升表征，但其嵌入常保留被试相关变异，给跨被试下游分类带来额外负担。DEFT作为即插即用微调适配器，将预训练token分支解耦为任务相关内容与被试一致风格，并仅从内容分支预测。它结合递归高斯精修、时间方差正则、被试感知对比学习与重构。在多个EEG数据集和四种EFM骨干上，DEFT优于匹配微调基线，消融支持内容/风格分支组织。
papers.abstract_en: EEG foundation models (EFMs) have improved EEG representation learning by transferring knowledge from large-scale multi-subject pretraining to downstream tasks. However, their pretrained embeddings often retain substantial subject-related variation, placing an additional burden on the downstream classifier, especially in cross-subject settings. To address this issue, we propose Disentangled EFM Fine-Tuning (DEFT), a plug-and-play adapter for EFM fine-tuning. DEFT encourages branch disentanglement of pretrained tokens into task-oriented content and subject-consistent style, then performs downstream prediction from the content branch. It instantiates this factorize-before-classify design with recursive Gaussian refinement, temporal-variance regularization, subject-aware contrastive learning, and reconstruction. Experiments across multiple EEG datasets and four EFM backbones show that DEFT improves matched fine-tuning baselines. Further ablations and analyses support the intended content/style branch organization.

papers.title_en: Nobody Truly Agrees on Sentiment: Humans, Bespoke Tools, and LLMs Struggle with Social Media Texts
papers.authors: Himarsha R. Jayanetti, Sivakanesan Dhanushkanda, Shuai Hao, Michael L. Nelson, Michele C. Weigle
papers.evidence: 情感标签上的人与模型标注不一致
papers.tldr: 社交媒体情感分析常被直接使用却忽视局限。该研究比较6名人类标注者、TextBlob/VADER/Twitter-roBERTa-base及三种LLM在100条推文上的一致性，使用Cohen's与Fleiss' kappa。人类间仅一般一致，二分类高于三分类；Twitter-roBERTa-base最贴近人类，LLM彼此较一致。结果强调领域微调与以人为中心评估对可靠情感分析至关重要。
papers.abstract_en: Social media is a rich source of real-time public sentiment, but widely used sentiment analysis tools are often applied without understanding their limitations. In this study, we evaluate the inter-rater reliability of three bespoke sentiment analysis tools (TextBlob, VADER, and Twitter-roBERTa-base) and three large language models (LLMs: Qwen3-32B, GPT-OSS-120B, Llama-4-Maverick-17B) against six human raters across 100 tweets. We measured agreement using two statistical measures: Cohen's kappa for pairwise comparisons and Fleiss' kappa for multiple raters. Even among the human raters, our results showed only fair agreement, highlighting the subjectivity of sentiment analysis. Higher agreement was observed under the binary sentiment classification (negative vs. non-negative and positive vs. non-positive) than under the three-class classification across both humans and automated tools. The Twitter-roBERTa-base model showed the strongest alignment with human ratings, outperforming both bespoke sentiment tools and LLMs, particularly in distinguishing negative versus non-negative sentiment. LLMs showed substantial agreement among themselves and moderate to substantial alignment with humans, performing better in positive vs. non-positive classifications. Our findings underscore that domain-specific fine-tuning remains crucial for reliable social media sentiment analysis, and human-centered evaluation remains essential for establishing gold-standard labels.

papers.title_en: Evidential Multimodal Transformers with Dempster-Shafer Fusion for Emotion Recognition
papers.evidence: 对矛盾或受损情感信号进行不确定性量化，处理模糊情感证据
papers.tldr: 多模态情感识别中，传感器损坏或模态矛盾时，softmax 方法仍会给出高置信预测。为此提出 EMT-DS：将预测建模为主观意见与 Dirichlet 分布，分离认知不确定性与偶然不确定性；各模态经 Transformer 编码后生成信念质量，再由 Dempster 组合规则融合，并以冲突系数 1/(1-c) 显式量化矛盾，使融合预测更分散而非强行一致。在四个基准上，IEMOCAP 达 84.3%，DEAP 为 82.4%，KEMDy20 为 96.8%，CMU-MOSEI 提升 2.4 个点；ECE 从 0.153 降至 0.042，音频强噪声下保持 71.2%。融合复杂度 O(MK^2)，冲突指标还能标记错误，审阅 20% 样本可捕获 80% 误分类，支持临床与安全关键场景的选择性预测。
papers.abstract_en: Softmax-based multimodal emotion recognition methods often assign high confidence even when sensor data are corrupted or contradictory, for example when facial expressions suggest positive valence while vocal prosody indicates negative arousal. We present an Evidential Multimodal Transformer with Dempster-Shafer Fusion (EMT-DS) that addresses this problem through formal uncertainty quantification. EMT-DS models predictions as Subjective Opinions (Dirichlet distributions), separating epistemic uncertainty (lack of evidence) from aleatoric uncertainty (sensor noise). Modality-specific transformer encoders produce belief mass distributions that are fused with Dempster's Rule of Combination, which normalizes the joint belief mass by a conflict coefficient 1/(1-c), so that contradictory evidence is explicitly quantified as conflict and the fused prediction becomes diffuse rather than being forced into an unjustified consensus. Under subject-independent and speaker-independent evaluation on four benchmarks, EMT-DS achieves 84.3% accuracy on IEMOCAP versus 81.7% for the best baseline (p < 0.01), 82.4% on DEAP under leave-one-subject-out evaluation versus 78.1%, and 96.8% on the highly imbalanced KEMDy20, and it improves accuracy on CMU-MOSEI by 2.4 points over the strongest evidential baseline. In controlled ablation, it reduces Expected Calibration Error from 0.153 (softmax transformer) to 0.042. It maintains 71.2% accuracy under severe Gaussian noise on audio features (sigma = 1.0), where attention baselines drop to 45.3%, and degrades gracefully when entire modalities are absent. The fusion step has O(MK^2) complexity, compared with O(M^2 d^2) for cross-modal attention. The learned conflict metric also flags likely errors: reviewing 20% of samples captures 80% of misclassifications, which supports selective prediction in clinical and safety-critical systems.

papers.title_en: Social Pain Disrupts Emotion-Action Brain-State Dynamics in Adolescents with Non-Suicidal Self-Injury
papers.authors: Ying Xu, Xiaojun Liang, Li Zhang, Yixuan Yuan, Gan Huang, Yongjie Zhou, Zhen Liang
papers.evidence: 结合域对抗学习的EEG情感-动作脑状态解码
papers.tldr: 青少年抑郁患者常伴非自杀性自伤（NSSI），但社交痛苦如何快速引发适应不良行为的脑状态动力学尚不清楚。研究结合实验性疼痛范式、脑电微状态分析和可解释深度序列模型，分析106名抑郁青少年（67名伴NSSI、39名不伴NSSI）在社交痛、生理痛与静息态下的神经动力学。社交痛条件下NSSI识别准确率达68.55%，优于最佳基线8.94个百分点；模型解释发现伴NSSI者MS3-MS5双向转换减弱，源定位提示情绪/内感受与动作准备耦合受损。该研究为客观识别NSSI提供了机制可解释的神经标记。
papers.abstract_en: Non-suicidal self-injury (NSSI) is prevalent among adolescents with depression, but the rapid brain-state dynamics linking social distress to maladaptive behavior remain unclear. We combine an experimental pain paradigm, electroencephalography (EEG) microstate analysis, and interpretable deep sequence modeling to investigate NSSI-related neurodynamics in 106 adolescents with depression, including 67 with NSSI (DN+) and 39 without NSSI (DN-), during social pain, physical pain, and resting-state conditions. A model integrating disease-specific, domain-adversarial, consistency, and contrastive learning captures higher-order dependencies in microstate sequences. Social pain yields the strongest NSSI discrimination, with 68.55% accuracy, outperforming the best baseline by 8.94% points. Model interpretation and conventional microstate analyses reveal weakened bidirectional transitions between MS3 and MS5 in DN+ adolescents during social pain. Source reconstruction associates MS3 with emotional/interoceptive processing and MS5 with action preparation, suggesting disrupted emotion-action coupling. Time-resolved analyses show greater early-to-middle action-state recruitment and later emotion-state recruitment in DN+ adolescents. In DN- adolescents, MS5-to-MS3 dynamics mediate associations between social-evaluation sensitivity and affective outcomes, whereas this mediation is absent in DN+; conversely, MS3-to-MS5 transitions are associated with greater negative affect in DN+. Together, these findings identify disrupted emotion-action coupling as a key neurodynamic mechanism underlying altered social pain processing in adolescents with NSSI, providing a mechanistically interpretable neural signature for objective identification of NSSI.

papers.title_en: HyBRA-EEG: Hyperbolic Global-Local Brain-Region Aggregation for Self-Supervised EEG Representation Learning
papers.authors: Xin Liu, Feng Lu, Wei Li
papers.evidence: 面向跨被试差异与异构蒙太奇的自监督EEG表征学习
papers.tldr: 脑电表征学习常受信号噪声、受试者差异和电极布局异构影响，现有自监督方法虽统一异构记录，却可能编码导联或数据集特异规律，限制跨数据集迁移。HyBRA提出双曲全局-局部脑区聚合，将异构通道观测映射到固定脑区token空间，融合电极坐标、脑区先验与特征相关双曲距离，并用通道证据注入分支保留细粒度判别线索。所得token经区域-时间Transformer处理，并以潜在特征和脑区信号掩码重建预训练。在六个基准数据集上平均平衡准确率领先，OpenBMI-MI六折评估中与CSBrain持平，AUROC提升1.84个百分点、AUPRC提升5.23个百分点，参数减少96.8%，TUAB/TUEV上双曲匹配优于欧氏距离与余弦相似度。
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalography (EEG) representation learning is challenged by noisy signals, inter-subject variability, and heterogeneous electrode montages in different datasets and recording settings. Recent self-supervised EEG pretraining methods improve transferability by converting heterogeneous recordings into unified token or sequence representations, but channel-aware designs may still encode montage- or dataset-specific regularities. We propose HyBRA, a self-supervised framework based on hyperbolic global-local brain-region aggregation. HyBRA maps heterogeneous channel observations into a fixed regional token space by combining electrode coordinates, region priors, and feature-dependent hyperbolic distances. A channel-evidence injection branch preserves fine-grained discriminative cues during aggregation. The resulting tokens are processed by a Region-Time Transformer and pretrained with masked reconstruction of latent features and region-level signals. HyBRA outperforms the compared methods in average balanced accuracy on six benchmark datasets. Under a controlled six-fold evaluation on OpenBMI-MI, HyBRA matches CSBrain in balanced accuracy, improves AUROC by 1.84 percentage points and AUPRC by 5.23 percentage points, and uses 96.8\% fewer parameters. Matched comparisons on TUAB and TUEV show higher balanced accuracy for hyperbolic matching than for Euclidean distance or cosine similarity.
